author: RamSet
releaseNotes: 1.3.0 - Open-Contact Pause now enforces the thermostat instead of trusting itself. Previously, once it had turned the thermostat off for an open window, it assumed it stayed off. If anything else switched the thermostat back on - the thermostat itself, its schedule, another app or a person - the HVAC ran with the windows open while the page still said PAUSED. Now, while a contact is open, any mode other than off is turned off again as soon as the thermostat reports it, and on a 5-minute check, and you get a notification saying so. After the windows close, the restored mode is checked for 15 minutes and re-sent if the thermostat did not take it. A mode you choose while everything is closed is left alone. Long pauses now read in hours and minutes. Press Done once on the Open-Contact Pause page after updating. 1.2.1 - Room Vent: the room-temperature pill is now coloured by where the room sits against its target - blue when colder, green when within half a degree, orange when warmer. While the thermostat is idle the target is the setpoint for its mode (in auto, anywhere between the heat and cool setpoints counts as on target); with the thermostat off there is no target and the pill is grey. The parent's per-helper line shows the same coloured pill. 1.2.0 - Every helper page now opens with a Current status block, in the same style as the Blinds Dusk Automation app. The parent shows the thermostat (state, mode, setpoints, humidity) and one line per helper saying what it is doing right now. Room Vent shows heating/cooling/idle, the room temperature against its target, the vent level the helper wants, each vent's actual level, when it last evaluated and when the next periodic re-check is due - an amber 'overdue' means the timer has stopped and Done restarts it. Open-Contact Pause shows paused/running with how long, a pending pause or resume with its countdown (that used to read as 'not paused - press Done' while the delay was still running), the thermostat, the delays, and one line per contact. Humidity shows the on/off decision and the reason, each outlet's actual state, heater state, humidity against the effective maximum, and the outdoor temperature when frost control is on. The status is computed by the same code that drives the helper, so it shows what the helper will actually do. Nothing to change in your settings. 1.1.1 - Open-Contact Pause: no more silent failures. If a contact is open but the app can't pause (no thermostat selected in the parent), it now says so on the Status page and logs a warning, instead of appearing 'not paused' with no explanation.

apps.name: Local Ecobee Helpers
apps.description: Parent app that hosts the Ecobee local helper child apps and holds the shared thermostat reference.

apps.name: Local Ecobee Room Vent
apps.description: Per-room vent control following the thermostat's heating/cooling state and setpoints, with an adjustable periodic re-evaluation and a minimum open floor.

apps.name: Local Ecobee Open-Contact Pause
apps.description: Pauses the entire HVAC while any monitored window/door contact is open, with minute-based delays and optional notifications.

apps.name: Local Ecobee Humidity
apps.description: Runs a humidifier switch/socket while the heater is on, up to a maximum desired humidity, with optional frost control.
